title: Dockerfile Check
description: Stops a Dockerfile shipping a root, leaky or slow image by reading it the way BuildKit does (escape directive, continuations, heredocs, stages) and flagging a final image that runs as root, secrets in ARG or ENV (Docker's own key rule), secret files baked in or carried over by COPY --from, COPY . before the dependency install, a missing .dockerignore, apt-get without -y, --no-install-recommends or list cleanup, ADD from a URL without --checksum, curl | sh and shell-form CMD or ENTRYPOINT that swallow SIGTERM, with one-tap fixes such as secret mounts, manifest-first installs and exec form.
stops: Docker image runs as root with secrets
